Taiwan FactCheck Academy



Recently, an article beginning with "Morris Chang's Farewell Letter" has been circulating online. It discusses Jensen Huang's influence on Taiwan's tech industry and the interaction when Chiang Wan-an gave Huang the key to the city. Our check found that the article was pieced together from scam messages and netizens' personal opinions, and was not written by Morris Chang.  
  
1. The article claims that TSMC founder Morris Chang left his autobiography to Taiwan as a gift. In fact, content such as "Morris Chang's Farewell Letter" was already spreading together with phishing websites as early as late 2025. It is a scam message that uses Morris Chang's name, and it was not written by him.  
  
2. The second half of the article says that NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang protects Taiwan in a different way, and that Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an showed high emotional intelligence when he gave Huang the key to the city. This content is actually netizens' personal opinions or comments, not statements by Morris Chang.  
  
The article is in fact a mix of scam messages that use Morris Chang's name and netizens' opinions about Jensen Huang and Chiang Wan-an. It did not come from Morris Chang, so it is "False" information with a false attribution.

## Background

An article recently went viral on social media, claiming to be "The Hero Takes His Final Bow: Morris Chang's Farewell Letter". It opens in the first-person voice of TSMC founder Morris Chang: "I am ve had 3 heart surgeries in 5 years. Diabetes taught me restraint, and it also made meunderstand that what a person can leave behind is not wealth but choices… My final gift to Taiwan is my autobiography".

The article then changes topic. It says NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has linkedsupply chain, so the world's hottest industry depends more and more on Taiwan, and that thin a different way". It also praises Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an, saying that when he gaveHuang the key to Taipei City, Huang said in public "Taiwan will always be my home" because of Chiang's high emotional intelligence, which he could not hide.
